page.overview:
Who is Gary?

Gary is a minor character, who briefly appears in Season 1.

Gary has a receding hairline, which makes him look a bit older or stressed. He appears to be light-skinned, though the exact tone isn’t super distinct. His outfit suggests he might be a low-level businessman or a office worker.

He seems to be a good caring father to his daughter.

Gary owed a debt to Machine Head who sent Titan to kill him but the latter discovers that Gary has a family, so he gives Gary the opportunity to settle the bill within two days. He may have settled the bill afterwards.
